304 days later:  
March has 31 days → days left in March: 6 (25 to 31 inclusive counts 7 days, so from March 26: 31-25=6 days used).  
304 - 6 = 298 days left.  
April (30) + May (31) + June (30) + July (31) + August (31) + September (30) + October (31) = 214 days (Jan 1 not reached yet).  
298 - 214 = 84 days into November. November has 30 days, so 84 days means into next year.
